verified_behavior: Native CloseRequested hides the main window when continuous collection is enabled.
The writer applies a selected synthetic native message to its Project while the window is hidden.
A real secondary process reopens the same main process; a foreground request arriving before window creation is retained.
Relative JSON passed by a real secondary process is resolved from its cwd and delivered to the existing renderer.
Renderer retains a popped path while busy and polls again after an empty result.
Owned login-unit configuration can be enabled/disabled through UI; disabling preserves the file and current process.
Unit publication uses a retained directory, anonymous temporary inode and atomic no-clobber link.
Foreign unit, symlink, unsafe directories, late foreign leaf and FIFO are rejected without overwrite or indefinite blocking.
Signal handling requests normal Tauri shutdown and the writer is joined before the single-instance plugin releases its D-Bus name.
